files_modified.behavior_after: New script (post-fix). Phase 2.5 Deterministic Merge. Accepts per-agent JSON files via --agent-{a1,a2,b,c,d} flags, --agents glob, or positional slug. Validates each agent output against contracts/agent-output.schema.json (reject malformed, continue). Merges findings via two-phase dedup: (1) rough key by (ep_id, sink_file, vuln_type) — no line; (2) _subgroup_by_line() pairwise ±5 connected-component within each rough group. Stored/cross-EP key: (store_ep_id, load_ep_id, storage_key, vuln_type). Same-verdict duplicates: merge evidence, keep highest confidence, record agent_agreement. Conflicts (different verdict same key): preserve BOTH findings as separate top-level entries, each with conflict=True + conflicting_verdicts list. Validates merged output against contracts/merge-output.schema.json (hard error on mismatch). Writes reports/<slug>-phase2-merged.json (archive) and reports/<slug>-phase2.json (canonical for gate).

deviations_from_spec.spec_says: session card critical_notes: merge_stats required fields include 'total_findings'
deviations_from_spec.resolution: Used total_raw + total_deduplicated per E1 (schema is authoritative contract). Also included duplicates_merged, conflicts_flagged, schema_errors, tp_count, fp_count, review_count as additional stats not prohibited by schema.

test_result: PASS (post-fix): CLI OK. 11 test cases verified including Codex-reported regressions: (Bug1a) lines 9+11 (diff=2≤5) → n=1, duplicates_merged=1; (Bug1b) lines 9+15 (diff=6>5) → n=2; (Bug1c) lines 5+10 (diff=5 boundary) → n=1; (Bug2) TP vs FP same key → 2 top-level findings, each conflict=True + conflicting_verdicts; (T2) same-verdict dedup → agent_agreement=2; (T4) malformed skipped; (T5) merge schema valid; (T6) all stats fields present; (T7) output files written; (T8) no existing files modified.
notes: Post-session Codex review identified 2 confirmed bugs (both with refutation-by-test): (1) sink_line ±5 was implemented as floor bucket (line//5)*5, causing boundary failures (lines 9 and 11 fell in different buckets). Fixed by two-phase dedup: rough key without line + pairwise ±5 connected-component sweep in _subgroup_by_line(). (2) Conflict path only preserved 1 top-level finding; spec requires 'preserve BOTH'. Fixed: _merge_group() now returns list[dict], conflicts produce 2 separate top-level findings each flagged conflict=True. Both fixes committed separately (58213b7).
